remarks: Welcome to this spacious and bright 3-bedroom, 3-bath multi-family rental property, perfect for families seeking a vibrant and convenient lifestyle. Situated in the renowned SoNo district, this property offers excellent commuting options for professionals working in nearby cities. It's also close to the popular Woodward Park Pickleball Courts!  The main level features a versatile living room and dining room, ideal for relaxation, entertainment, or hosting guests. The fresh hardwood floors throughout the property exudes a modern ambiance, while the carpets in two of the bedrooms and hallway add a cozy and comfortable touch.  On the third level, you'll find a full bath and two additional bonus rooms, which can be customized to suit your needs. Whether you require a home office, an exercise room, a playroom, or any other space, these bonus rooms provide flexibility and convenience. Additionally, the property boasts ample storage space, ensuring you have plenty of room to keep your belongings organized.  Don't miss the opportunity to make this well-appointed and conveniently located rental your new home.  Please note: Pets are not allowed.
